description: Report how this assistant is connected to FirmLedger: public (no sign-in), an API key, or the member's account through sign-in (OAuth). Shows Free or Pro, the trial status, which tools and fields are available, and whether the sign-in token is about to expire. Use it when the member asks whether they are connected or signed in, or why something is locked.
name: get_connection_status
title: Get FirmLedger connection status
